verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents its own bulk-operation feature: large SQL operations run as batches of retryable tasks, with live progress and pause/retry/cancel controls. Cross-table partition operations move data by reference, and agents can run SQL over MCP. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the batch-task feature (limits, scope, API), explicit evidence that agents can drive batch jobs through MCP or CHKit, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Run large SQL operations as batches of retryable tasks against your service, with live progress and controls to pause, retry, or cancel while the job runs.
Cross-table partition operations work by reference: the coordination layer re-points parts to the target table, so no row data is copied.
tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring
